name: Question 9
problem:
The velocity vector $v=⟨u,v⟩,$ measured in $\text{m}/\text{s},$ of a particle $P$ at time $t$ seconds is given by

$$
v=⟨-2\sqrt{2}\operatorname{cos}⁡2t,\sqrt{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡2t⟩.
$$

Find the magnitude of the acceleration of $P$ at time $t=\frac{\pi }{8}.$
worked_solution:
To compute the acceleration vector, we differentiate the velocity vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}a & =\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t} \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}t},\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}t}⟩ \\  & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(-2\sqrt{2}\operatorname{cos}⁡2t),\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\sqrt{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡2t)⟩ \\  & =⟨4\sqrt{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡2t,2\sqrt{2}\operatorname{cos}⁡2t⟩\end{aligned}
$$

To find the acceleration at time $t=\frac{\pi }{8},$ we substitute $t=\frac{\pi }{8}$ into the above:

$$
\begin{aligned}a(\frac{\pi }{8}) & =⟨4\sqrt{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡(2\cdot \frac{\pi }{8}),2\sqrt{2}\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\cdot \frac{\pi }{8})⟩ \\  & =⟨4\sqrt{2}\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4}),2\sqrt{2}\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{4})⟩ \\  & =⟨4\sqrt{2}\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},2\sqrt{2}\cdot \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}⟩ \\  & =⟨4,2⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, to find the magnitude of the acceleration, we compute $|a(\frac{\pi }{8})|:$ 

$$
\begin{aligned}|a(\frac{\pi }{8})| & =|⟨4,2⟩| \\  & =\sqrt{{4}^{2}+{2}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{16+4} \\  & =\sqrt{20} \\  & =2\sqrt{5}\,{\text{m/s}}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Question 9
?

The velocity vector v=⟨u,v⟩, measured in m/s, of a particle P at time t seconds is given by v=⟨−22cos⁡2t,2sin⁡2t⟩. Find the magnitude of the acceleration of P at time t=π8.

a
5m/s2
b
5m/s2
c
52m/s2
d
2m/s2
e
25m/s2
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

To compute the acceleration vector, we differentiate the velocity vector: a=dvdt=⟨dudt,dvdt⟩=⟨ddt(−22cos⁡2t),ddt(2sin⁡2t)⟩=⟨42sin⁡2t,22cos⁡2t⟩

To find the acceleration at time t=π8, we substitute t=π8 into the above: a(π8)=⟨42sin⁡(2⋅π8),22cos⁡(2⋅π8)⟩=⟨42sin⁡(π4),22cos⁡(π4)⟩=⟨42⋅22,22⋅22⟩=⟨4,2⟩

Finally, to find the magnitude of the acceleration, we compute |a(π8)|: |a(π8)|=|⟨4,2⟩|=42+22=16+4=20=25m/s2
